nodes.en: 【1】Figure 12.14【/1】 Iteration 1 of the while-loop in the running example.
nodes.zh: 【1】图 12.14【/1】 示例中 while 循环的第 1 次迭代。

nodes.en: Note that in 【1】Fig. 12.13【/1】, A_consumed (line 48) and C_completed are accumulated through the while-loop iterations. Also, B_consumed is derived from the accumulated A_consumed and C_completed values, so it is also accumulated through the while-loop iterations. Therefore they always reflect the number of A and B elements that are consumed by all the iterations so far. At the beginning of each iteration the tiles to be loaded for the iteration always start with A[A_curr + A_consumed] and B[B_curr + B_consumed].
nodes.zh: 注意，在【1】图 12.13【/1】中，A_consumed（第 48 行）和 C_completed 在 while 循环的迭代过程中不断累加。此外，B_consumed 由累加后的 A_consumed 和 C_completed 值推导而来，因此它也在 while 循环的迭代过程中不断累加。因此，它们始终反映到目前为止所有迭代消耗的 A 和 B 元素数量。在每次迭代开始时，本次迭代要加载的分块总是从 A[A_curr + A_consumed] 和 B[B_curr + B_consumed] 开始。

nodes.en: During the last iterations of the while-loop, there may not be enough input A or B elements to fill the input tiles in the shared memory for some of the thread blocks. For example, in 【1】Fig. 12.14【/1】, for thread block 2, the number of remaining A elements for iteration 1 is less than the tile size. An if-statement should be used to prevent the threads from attempting to load elements that are outside the input subarrays for the block. The first if-statement in 【2】Fig. 12.12【/2】 (line 27) detects such attempts by checking whether the index of the A_S element that a thread is trying to load exceeds the number of remaining A elements given by the value of the expression A_length − A_consumed. The if-statement ensures that the threads load only the elements that are within the remaining section of the A subarray. The same is done for the B elements (line 32).
nodes.zh: 在 while 循环的最后几次迭代中，某些线程块可能没有足够的输入 A 或 B 元素来填满共享内存中的输入分块。例如，在【1】图 12.14【/1】中，对于线程块 2，第 1 次迭代剩余 A 元素的数量小于分块大小。应当使用 if 语句防止线程尝试加载线程块输入子数组之外的元素。【2】图 12.12【/2】中的第一个 if 语句（第 27 行）通过检查线程试图加载的 A_S 元素的索引是否超过表达式 A_length − A_consumed 的值所给出的剩余 A 元素数量，来检测这类尝试。该 if 语句确保线程只加载位于 A 子数组剩余区段内的元素。B 元素也做了同样的处理（第 32 行）。

nodes.en: With the if-statements and the index expressions, the tile loading process should work well as long as A_consumed and B_consumed give the total number of A and B elements consumed by the thread block in previous iterations of the while-loop. This brings us to the code at the end of the while-loop in 【1】Fig. 12.13【/1】. These statements update the total number of C elements generated by the while-loop iterations thus far. For all but the last iteration, each iteration generates additional tile_size C elements.
nodes.zh: 有了 if 语句和索引表达式，只要 A_consumed 和 B_consumed 给出线程块在 while 循环此前各次迭代中消耗的 A 和 B 元素总数，分块加载过程就能正常工作。接下来我们看【1】图 12.13【/1】中 while 循环末尾的代码。这些语句更新到目前为止 while 循环迭代生成的 C 元素总数。除最后一次迭代外，每次迭代都会额外生成 tile_size 个 C 元素。

nodes.en: The next two statements update the total number of A and B elements consumed by the threads in the block. For all but the last iteration the number of additional A elements consumed by the thread block is the returned value of
nodes.zh: 接下来的两条语句更新线程块中线程消耗的 A 和 B 元素总数。除最后一次迭代外，线程块额外消耗的 A 元素数量是下式的返回值：

nodes.en: As we mentioned before, the calculation of the number of elements consumed may not be correct at the end of the last iteration of the while-loop. There may not be a full tile of elements left for the final iteration. However, since the while-loop will not iterate any further, the A_consumed, B_consumed, and C_completed values will not be used so the incorrect results will not cause any harm. However, one should remember that if for any reason these values are needed after exiting the while-loop, the three variables will not have the correct values. The values of A_length, B_length, and C_length should be used instead, since all the elements in the designated subarrays to the thread block will have been consumed at the exit of the while-loop.
nodes.zh: 正如我们之前提到的，在 while 循环最后一次迭代结束时，所消耗元素数量的计算结果可能不正确。最后一次迭代可能没有完整分块的元素可供使用。不过，由于 while 循环不会继续迭代，A_consumed、B_consumed 和 C_completed 这些值将不会被使用，因此不正确的结果不会造成任何影响。但应当记住，如果出于任何原因在退出 while 循环后需要这些值，这三个变量将不具有正确的值。此时应改用 A_length、B_length 和 C_length 的值，因为在 while 循环退出时，分配给线程块的子数组中的所有元素都将已被消耗。

nodes.en: The tiled kernel achieves substantial reduction in global memory accesses by the co-rank function and makes the global memory accesses coalesce. However, as is, the kernel has a significant deficiency. It makes use of only half of the data that is loaded into the shared memory in each iteration. The unused data in the shared memory is simply reloaded in the next iteration. This wastes half of the memory bandwidth. In the next section we will present a circular buffer scheme for managing the tiles of data elements in the shared memory, which allows the kernel to fully utilize all the A and B elements that have been loaded into the shared memory. As we will see, this increased efficiency comes with a substantial increase in code complexity.
nodes.zh: 分块核函数使协秩函数对全局内存的访问大幅减少，并实现了全局内存访问的合并。然而，就现状而言，这个核函数有一个显著的缺陷：它每次迭代只使用了加载到共享内存中的数据的一半。共享内存中未使用的数据在下次迭代中被简单地重新加载，这浪费了一半的内存带宽。在下一节中，我们将介绍一种用于管理共享内存中数据元素分块的环形缓冲区方案，它使核函数能够充分利用已加载到共享内存中的所有 A 和 B 元素。正如我们将看到的，这种效率的提升伴随着代码复杂度的显著增加。

nodes.en: 12.7 A circular buffer merge kernel
nodes.zh: 12.7 环形缓冲区归并核函数

nodes.en: The design of the circular buffer merge kernel, which will be referred to as merge_circular_buffer_kernel, is largely the same as that of the merge_tiled_kernel kernel in the previous section. The main difference lies in the management of the A and B elements in the shared memory to enable full utilization of all the elements loaded from the global memory. The overall structure of the merge_tiled_kernel is shown in 【1】Figs. 12.12【/1】 through 【2】12.14【/2】; it assumes that the tiles of the A and B elements always start at A_S[0] and B_S[0], respectively. After each while-loop iteration the kernel loads the next tile, starting from A_S[0] and B_S[0]. The inefficiency of the merge_tiled_kernel comes from the fact that part of the next tiles of elements are in the shared memory, but we reload the entire tile from the global memory and write over these remaining elements from the previous iteration.
nodes.zh: 环形缓冲区归并核函数（下文简称 merge_circular_buffer_kernel）的设计，与上一节中 merge_tiled_kernel 核函数的设计大体相同。主要区别在于共享内存中 A 和 B 元素的管理方式，其目的是充分利用从全局内存加载的所有元素。merge_tiled_kernel 的整体结构如【1】图 12.12【/1】至【2】图 12.14【/2】所示；它假设 A 和 B 元素的分块总是分别从 A_S[0] 和 B_S[0] 开始。每完成一次 while 循环迭代，核函数就从 A_S[0] 和 B_S[0] 开始加载下一个分块。merge_tiled_kernel 的效率低下源于这样一个事实：下一批分块中的一部分元素已经在共享内存中，但我们却从全局内存重新加载整个分块，从而覆盖了上一次迭代剩余的这些元素。

nodes.en: 【1】Fig. 12.15【/1】 shows the main idea of merge_circular_buffer_kernel. We will continue to use the example from 【2】Figs. 12.10【/2】 and 【3】12.14【/3】. Two additional variables, A_S_start and B_S_start, are added to allow each iteration of the while-loop in 【4】Fig. 12.12【/4】 to start its A and B tiles at dynamically determined positions inside A_S[0] and B_S[0], respectively. This added tracking allows each iteration of the while-loop to start the tiles with the remaining A and B elements from the previous iteration. Since there is no previous iteration when we first enter the while-loop, these two variables are initialized to 0 before entering the while-loop.
nodes.zh: 【1】图 12.15【/1】展示了 merge_circular_buffer_kernel 的主要思想。我们将继续使用【2】图 12.10【/2】和【3】图 12.14【/3】中的示例。新增了两个变量 A_S_start 和 B_S_start，使【4】图 12.12【/4】中 while 循环的每次迭代能够分别从 A_S[0] 和 B_S[0] 内部动态确定的位置开始其 A 和 B 分块。这一额外的追踪机制使 while 循环的每次迭代能够以上一次迭代剩余的 A 和 B 元素开始分块。由于首次进入 while 循环时不存在上一次迭代，这两个变量在进入 while 循环之前被初始化为 0。

nodes.en: 【1】Figure 12.15【/1】 A circular buffer scheme for managing the shared memory tiles.
nodes.zh: 【1】图 12.15【/1】 一种管理共享内存分块的环形缓冲区方案。

nodes.en: During iteration 0, since the values of A_S_start and B_S_start are both 0, the tiles will start with A_S[0] and B_S[0]. This is illustrated in 【1】Fig. 12.15A【/1】, where we show the tiles that will be loaded from the global memory (A and B) into the shared memory (A_S and B_S) as light gray sections. Once these tiles have been loaded into the shared memory, merge_circular_buffer_kernel will proceed with the merge operation in the same way as the merge_tile_kernel.
nodes.zh: 在第 0 次迭代中，由于 A_S_start 和 B_S_start 的值都是 0，分块将从 A_S[0] 和 B_S[0] 开始。这一点如【1】图 12.15A【/1】所示，我们把将从全局内存（A 和 B）加载到共享内存（A_S 和 B_S）的分块显示为浅灰色区段。一旦这些分块被加载到共享内存中，merge_circular_buffer_kernel 就会以与 merge_tile_kernel 相同的方式进行归并操作。

nodes.en: We also need to update the A_S_start and B_S_start variables for use in the next iteration by advancing the value of these variables by the number of A and B elements consumed from the shared memory during the current iteration. Keep in mind that the size of each buffer is limited to tile_size. At some point, we will need to reuse the buffer locations at the beginning part of the A_S and B_S arrays. This is done by checking whether the new A_S_start and B_S_start values exceed the tile_size. If so, we subtract tile_size from them as shown in the following if-statement:
nodes.zh: 我们还需要更新 A_S_start 和 B_S_start 变量以供下次迭代使用，方法是让这两个变量的值前进本次迭代期间从共享内存消耗的 A 和 B 元素数量。请记住，每个缓冲区的大小限制为 tile_size。在某个时刻，我们将需要复用 A_S 和 B_S 数组开头部分的缓冲区位置。具体做法是检查新的 A_S_start 和 B_S_start 值是否超过 tile_size。如果是，就从它们中减去 tile_size，如下面的 if 语句所示：

nodes.en: 【1】Fig. 12.15B【/1】 illustrates the update of the A_S_start and B_S_start variables. At the end of iteration 0 a portion of the A tile and a portion of the B tile have been consumed. The consumed portions are shown as white sections in A_S and B_S in 【2】Fig. 12.15B【/2】. We update the A_S_start and B_S_start values to the position immediately after the consumed sections in the shared memory.
nodes.zh: 【1】图 12.15B【/1】展示了 A_S_start 和 B_S_start 变量的更新。在第 0 次迭代结束时，A 分块的一部分和 B 分块的一部分已被消耗。在【2】图 12.15B【/2】中，被消耗的部分显示为 A_S 和 B_S 中的白色区段。我们把 A_S_start 和 B_S_start 的值更新为共享内存中被消耗区段之后紧邻的位置。

nodes.en: 【1】Fig. 12.15C【/1】 illustrates the operations for filling the A and B tiles at the beginning of iteration 1 of the while-loop. A_S_consumed is a variable that is added to track the number of A elements used in the current iteration. The variable is useful for filling the tile in the next iteration. At the beginning of each iteration we need to load a section of up to A_S_consumed elements to fill up the A tile in the shared memory. Similarly, we need to load a section of up to B_S_consumed elements to fill up the B tile in the shared memory. The two sections that are loaded are shown as dark gray sections in 【2】Fig. 12.15C【/2】. Note that the tiles effectively “wrap around” in the A_S and B_S arrays, since we are reusing the space of the A and B elements that were consumed during iteration 0.
nodes.zh: 【1】图 12.15C【/1】展示了 while 循环第 1 次迭代开始时填充 A 和 B 分块的操作。A_S_consumed 是一个新增的变量，用于跟踪当前迭代中使用的 A 元素数量。该变量对填充下一次迭代的分块很有用。在每次迭代开始时，我们需要加载一个长度最多为 A_S_consumed 个元素的区段，以填满共享内存中的 A 分块。同样，我们需要加载一个长度最多为 B_S_consumed 个元素的区段，以填满共享内存中的 B 分块。加载的这两个区段在【2】图 12.15C【/2】中显示为深灰色区段。注意，由于我们复用了第 0 次迭代期间消耗的 A 和 B 元素的空间，分块实际上在 A_S 和 B_S 数组中“环绕”。

nodes.en: 【1】Fig. 12.15D【/1】 illustrates the updates to A_S_start and B_S_start at the end of iteration 1. The sections of elements that were consumed during iteration 1 are shown as the white sections. Note that in A_S, the consumed section wraps around to the beginning part of A_S. The value of the A_S_start variable is also wrapped around by the % modulo operator. It should be clear that we will need to adjust the code for loading and using the tiled elements to support this circular usage of the A_S and B_S arrays.
nodes.zh: 【1】图 12.15D【/1】展示了第 1 次迭代结束时对 A_S_start 和 B_S_start 的更新。第 1 次迭代期间消耗的元素区段显示为白色区段。注意，在 A_S 中，被消耗的区段环绕到了 A_S 的开头部分。A_S_start 变量的值也由 % 取模运算符实现环绕。显然，我们需要调整加载和使用分块元素的代码，以支持对 A_S 和 B_S 数组的这种环形使用方式。

nodes.en: Part 1 of merge_circular_buffer_kernel is identical to that of merge_tiled_kernel in 【1】Fig. 12.11【/1】, so we will not present it. 【2】Fig. 12.16【/2】 shows part 2 of the circular buffer kernel. Refer to 【3】Fig. 12.12【/3】 for variable declarations that remain the same. New variables A_S_start, B_S_start, A_S_consumed, and B_S_consumed are initialized to 0 before we enter the while-loop.
nodes.zh: merge_circular_buffer_kernel 的第 1 部分与【1】图 12.11【/1】中 merge_tiled_kernel 的第 1 部分相同，因此我们不再展示。【2】图 12.16【/2】展示了环形缓冲区核函数的第 2 部分。相同的变量声明请参见【3】图 12.12【/3】。新变量 A_S_start、B_S_start、A_S_consumed 和 B_S_consumed 在进入 while 循环之前被初始化为 0。

nodes.en: 【1】Figure 12.16【/1】 Part 2 of a circular buffer merge kernel.
nodes.zh: 【1】图 12.16【/1】 环形缓冲区归并核函数的第 2 部分。

nodes.en: Note that the exit conditions of the two for-loops have been adjusted. Instead of always loading a full tile, as was the case in the merge kernel in 【1】Fig. 12.12【/1】, each for-loop in 【2】Fig. 12.16【/2】 is set up to load only the number of elements that are needed to refill the tiles, given by A_S_consumed. The section of the A elements to be loaded by a thread block in the ith for-loop iteration starts at global memory location A[A_curr + A_consumed + i]. Note that i is incremented by blockDim.x after each iteration. Thus the A element to be loaded by a thread in the ith for-loop iteration is A[A_curr + A_consumed + i + threadIdx.x]. The index for each thread to place its A element into the A_S array is A_S_start + (tile_size − A_S_consumed) + I + threadIdx, since the tile starts at A_S[A_S_start] and there are (tile_size − A_S_consumed) elements remaining in the buffer from the previous iteration of the while-loop. The modulo (%) operation checks whether the index value is greater than or equal to tile_size. If it is, it is wrapped back into the beginning part of the array by subtracting tile_size from the index value. The same analysis applies to the for-loop for loading the B tile and is left as an exercise for the reader.
nodes.zh: 注意，两个 for 循环的退出条件已被调整。与【1】图 12.12【/1】中归并核函数总是加载完整分块不同，【2】图 12.16【/2】中的每个 for 循环都被设置为只加载重新填满分块所需的元素数量，该数量由 A_S_consumed 给出。线程块在第 i 次 for 循环迭代中要加载的 A 元素区段从全局内存位置 A[A_curr + A_consumed + i] 开始。注意，每次迭代后 i 都会按 blockDim.x 递增。因此，线程在第 i 次 for 循环迭代中要加载的 A 元素是 A[A_curr + A_consumed + i + threadIdx.x]。每个线程把其 A 元素放入 A_S 数组的索引是 A_S_start + (tile_size − A_S_consumed) + I + threadIdx，因为分块从 A_S[A_S_start] 开始，并且缓冲区中还剩余上一次 while 循环迭代留下的 (tile_size − A_S_consumed) 个元素。取模（%）运算检查索引值是否大于或等于 tile_size。如果是，就把该索引值减去 tile_size，使其绕回数组的开头部分。同样的分析适用于加载 B 分块的 for 循环，留给读者作为练习。

nodes.en: Using the A_S and B_S arrays as circular buffers also incurs additional complexity in the implementation of the co-rank and merge functions. Part of the additional complexity could be reflected in the thread-level code that calls these functions. However, in general, it is better if one can efficiently handle the complexities inside the library functions to minimize the increased level of complexity in the user code. We show such an approach in 【1】Fig. 12.17【/1】. 【2】Fig. 12.17A【/2】 shows the implementation of the circular buffer. A_S_start and B_S_start mark the beginning of the tile in the circular buffer. The tiles wrap around in the A_S and B_S arrays, shown as the light gray section to the left of A_S_start and B_S_start.
nodes.zh: 把 A_S 和 B_S 数组用作环形缓冲区，也会给协秩函数和归并函数的实现带来额外的复杂度。这部分额外的复杂度有一部分会体现在调用这些函数的线程级代码中。然而，一般而言，最好能在库函数内部高效地处理这些复杂性，以尽量减少用户代码中增加的复杂度。我们在【1】图 12.17【/1】中展示了这样一种方法。【2】图 12.17A【/2】展示了环形缓冲区的实现。A_S_start 和 B_S_start 标明了环形缓冲区中分块的起始位置。分块在 A_S 和 B_S 数组中环绕，显示为 A_S_start 和 B_S_start 左侧的浅灰色区段。

nodes.en: 【1】Figure 12.17【/1】 A simplified model for the co-rank values when using a circular buffer.
nodes.zh: 【1】图 12.17【/1】 使用环形缓冲区时协秩值的简化模型。

nodes.en: Keep in mind that the co-rank values are used for threads to identify the starting position, ending position, and length of the input subarrays that they are to use. When we employ circular buffers, we could provide the co-rank values as the actual indices in the circular buffer. However, this would incur quite a bit of complexity in the merge_circular_buffer_kernel code. For example, the a_next value could be smaller than the a_curr value, since the tile is wrapped around in the A_S array. Thus one would need to test for the case and calculate the length of the section as a_next-a_curr + tile_size. However, in other cases when a_next is larger than a_curr, the length of the section is simply a_next − a_curr.
nodes.zh: 请记住，协秩值用于让线程确定它们要使用的输入子数组的起始位置、结束位置和长度。在使用环形缓冲区时，我们可以把协秩值直接提供为环形缓冲区中的实际索引。然而，这会给 merge_circular_buffer_kernel 代码带来相当大的复杂度。例如，a_next 的值可能小于 a_curr 的值，因为分块在 A_S 数组中发生了环绕。因此，需要针对这种情况进行判断，并把区段的长度计算为 a_next-a_curr + tile_size。然而，在 a_next 大于 a_curr 的其他情况下，区段的长度就是 a_next − a_curr。

nodes.en: 【1】Fig. 12.17B【/1】 shows a simplified model for defining, deriving, and using the co-rank values with the circular buffer. In this model, each tile appears to be in a continuous section starting at A_S_start and B_S_start. In the case of the B_S tile in 【2】Fig. 12.17A【/2】, b_next is wrapped around and would be smaller than b_curr in the circular buffer. However, as is shown in 【3】Fig. 12.17B【/3】, the simplified model provides the illusion that all elements are in a continuous section of up to tile_size elements; thus a_next is always larger than or equal to a_curr, and b_next is always larger than or equal to b_curr. It is up to the implementation of the co_rank_circular and merge_sequential_circular functions to map this simplified view of the co-rank values into the actual circular buffer indices so that they can carry out their functionalities correctly and efficiently.
nodes.zh: 【1】图 12.17B【/1】展示了一个用于在环形缓冲区中定义、推导和使用协秩值的简化模型。在这个模型中，每个分块看起来都位于一个从 A_S_start 和 B_S_start 开始的连续区段中。在【2】图 12.17A【/2】中 B_S 分块的情况下，b_next 发生了环绕，在环形缓冲区中会小于 b_curr。然而，如【3】图 12.17B【/3】所示，该简化模型营造了一种假象，即所有元素都位于一个长度最多为 tile_size 个元素的连续区段中；因此 a_next 始终大于或等于 a_curr，b_next 也始终大于或等于 b_curr。需要由 co_rank_circular 和 merge_sequential_circular 函数的实现来把这个关于协秩值的简化视图映射为环形缓冲区的实际索引，以便它们能够正确而高效地完成各自的功能。

nodes.en: The co_rank_circular and merge_sequential_circular functions have the same set of parameters as the original co_rank and merge functions plus three additional parameters: A_S_start, B_S_start, and tile_size. These three additional parameters inform the functions where the current starting point of the buffers are and how big the buffers are. 【1】Fig. 12.18【/1】 shows the revised thread-level code based on the simplified model for the co-rank value using circular buffers. The only change to the code is that the co_rank_circular and merge_sequential_circular functions are called instead of the co_rank and merge functions. This demonstrates that a well-designed library interface can reduce the impact on the user code when employing sophisticated data structures.
nodes.zh: co_rank_circular 和 merge_sequential_circular 函数与原来的 co_rank 和 merge 函数具有相同的参数集合，另外还多了三个参数：A_S_start、B_S_start 和 tile_size。这三个额外参数告知函数缓冲区当前的起始位置在哪里以及缓冲区有多大。【1】图 12.18【/1】展示了基于使用环形缓冲区的协秩值简化模型修改后的线程级代码。代码中唯一的变化是调用 co_rank_circular 和 merge_sequential_circular 函数，而不是 co_rank 和 merge 函数。这表明，设计良好的库接口可以降低采用复杂数据结构时对用户代码的影响。
